chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
stem: 基于风险的方法(RBA)意味着各国、主管当局和金融机构:

options.A: 可免于采取措施缓解被评估为低水平的洗钱/恐怖融资风险
options.B: 应将所有剩余风险降低至较低水平
options.C: 应当识别、评估并理解其面临的洗钱与恐怖融资风险
options.D: 将合规资源分配给与合规无关的任务

stem_en: A risk-based approach (RBA) means that countries, competent authorities, and financial institutions:

options_en.A: Are exempt from mitigating AML/CFT risks assessed as low
options_en.B: Are expected to reduce all residual risks to low
options_en.C: Are expected to identify, assess, and understand the AML/CFT risks to which they are exposed
options_en.D: Will allocate compliance resources to non-compliance-related tasks
